name: Gron Thunderfist
title: The Iron Fist of Stormhold
description: A broad-shouldered half-orc standing over six feet tall, with ash-gray skin and pale green eyes. His shaved head bears a single scar, and his booming voice carries the weight of his many battles.

lineage: Raised in the human militia of Stormhold

notable_events.event: Held back a goblin horde at the Bridge of Ash during the Night of Cinders
Completed a solo contract to eliminate the Redfang Pirates

inventory.name: Stormcleaver
inventory.description: A massive two-handed greatsword rumored to crack like thunder when swung.

inventory.name: Pendant of the Defeated
inventory.description: A red crystal pendant taken from the leader of the Redfang Pirates as proof of victory.
